one_liner: Linear has a broad GraphQL API with self-serve OAuth2 apps and personal API keys, included on the free plan, plus an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth2 authorization-code flow with self-serve app registration, optional actor=app, and personal API keys. The MCP server also accepts OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, bearer tokens, or Linear API keys.
access_notes: Linear's own pricing page lists "API and webhook access" as Included on the Free plan, which is $0 with unlimited members. MCP access is also included on Free.
blocker_notes: None. A free workspace gives OAuth app registration and API keys.

evidence.quote: Create a new [OAuth2 Application](https://linear.app/settings/api/applications/new) and configure the redirect callback URLs to your application.
The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.
| API and webhook access | Included | Included | Included | Included |
Read-write access is provided through `https://mcp.linear.app/mcp` by default.
Linear’s MCP server follows the authenticated remote [MCP spec](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-03-26), so the server is centrally hosted and managed.
